jobs.roleTag: Software Engineer Intern — AI-First & GenAI Focus
jobs.elig: Currently enrolled in the 7th semester of a full-time B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science and available for internship in the 8th semester.
jobs.desc: Wayfair is recruiting Software Engineer Interns for AI-first engineering work in Bengaluru. Interns may work with teams spanning Search & Recommendations, Storefront, Supply Chain Retail, Marketing Technology, ML Platforms & Infrastructure and Global Supplier Tech. The role emphasizes software engineering, machine learning and integrating Generative AI tools into the development lifecycle.
resp: Contribute to applications, web services and data systems supporting Wayfair's technology teams.
Work on software engineering challenges across search, storefront, supply chain, marketing, ML platforms or supplier technology, depending on team placement.
Explore AI-assisted development, coding, testing and other software lifecycle activities.
jobs.who: Current 7th-semester full-time B.E./B.Tech Computer Science students who can undertake the internship during their 8th semester; refer to Wayfair for exact application requirements.
jobs.qualification: Full-time B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science (currently in 7th semester)
